gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
There are several ways of getting to the Agility Pyramid:
• The fastest way is to use the Jaleustrophos teleport of the Pharaoh's sceptre.
• Use the Desert amulet 2 or better to teleport to Nardah and run south-west.
• Take magic carpet from Shantay Pass to Sophanem (requires partial completion of Icthlarin's Little Helper), and walk north-east to the pyramid.
• Take magic carpet to Nardah, and walk south-west from Nardah.
• Use the Heart teleport and run south.
• Teleport to Menaphos lodestone, go to Sophanem, and exit the gate from there (requires partial completion of The Jack of Spades and completion of Contact!).

437.d: Ah Za Rhoon, which means Magnificence floating on water in an ancient language, was an ancient temple in Karamja that was built by Zadimus and destroyed by Rashiliyia.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The temple is located in the eastern island of Karamja, at a waterfall located roughly to the east of Shilo Village. From Tai Bwo Wannai, travel east and cross a wooden log and then follow the river bank south until you reach a mound of earth near the waterfall.

If you have access to the gnome glider network, you can travel to Al Kharid, take the glider to the Gnome Stronghold, and then take the glider to "gandius" (Karamja). From there, walk a little north-west to reach the mound of earth.

"Search" the mound of earth and click the option to use your spade to dig it up, the one on your tool belt should work. Light your torch and use it on the fissure to illuminate it – you will lose the light source. Add a rope to the fissure, securing it to the lip. Search the fissure again to climb down into the temple below – 32 Agility is a requirement. After a short period of time, the earth forms back over the entrance. Your light source and rope will be permanently in place.

Prior to handing the wampum belt to Trufitus during Shilo Village, both the search and examine options will result in the message "It just looks like some bumpy ground", and the temple cannot be entered.

444.d: The air altar is a runecrafting altar located in the Air Rune Temple, which is used to craft air runes from rune essence or pure essence with the Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players can enter the ruins with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• An air talisman
• An elemental talisman
• An omni-talisman
• An air tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• An air talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, but not in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break an air altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use a skills necklace to teleport to the Cooking Guild, then go south-west to the altar.
• The skull sceptre to teleport to Barbarian Village, then go east across the bridge to the altar.
